title: Mining Engineering, B.S. (College of Earth and Mineral Sciences)
notes: Built from the archived 2025-26 bulletin (raw HTML fetched and cross-checked against its own printed subtotals, not just WebFetch's summary). Program Requirements table and Suggested Academic Plan are byte-identical to the 2024-25 archive (MINE-2024.json) in every course, credit value, option pairing, and term placement -- direct diff of both years' extracted course lists and suggested-plan text found zero differences (the '(FALL ONLY)'/'(SPRING ONLY)' annotations from 2024-25 are dropped from this 2025-26 scrape's plain-text rendering, but the underlying Fall/Spring placement of every course is unchanged). 131 total credits, same as every prior archived year. This plan is therefore modeled identically to MINE-2024.json: STAT 401/EME 210 (STAT 401 first, for MNG 412's real prereq), ME 300 for the Thermodynamics category (Suggested Plan text still literally says 'EME 301 or ME 201', same longstanding table-vs-plan mismatch present in every year checked including the live 2026 bulletin), CE 360 added alongside EME 303 (Fluid Mechanics category, never named in the Suggested Plan text itself), CMPSC 203 dropped from the CMPSC 200/201 Programming pairing, CE 209 used exclusively for the MNG 223 alternate (MNG 223 has no title in this archive's Requirements table, same as 2024-25 and the live 2026 page, and isn't in Backend/catalogs/mng_catalog.json regardless of year), the MATH 3/4/21/22 chain added for the same current-catalog-driven CHEM 110 prereq gap documented in every other year's file, and EME 460 + MNG 412 modeled as two standalone required items (not one alternative pick) for the same real MNG 451W capstone AND-chain reason (MNG 331 + MNG 404 + MNG 412 + MNG 422) MINE-2026.json's notes describe. Semesters 5-6 mirror the 2024-25/2026 term placement (ENGL 202C and GHW in 3rd-year Fall, MNG 404 in 3rd-year Spring), not the older 2022-23/2023-24 arrangement. 'At which campus can I study this program?' section of this archived page: Begin Campus 'Any Penn State Campus', End Campus 'University Park' only, unchanged across every year checked (2022 through live 2026) -- see MINE-2026.json for this major's full campus-check finding. The 'Mining Engineering, B.S. at Commonwealth Campuses' Suggested Academic Plan on this same page keeps 2024-25's 130-132 total-credit range and unchanged course list.
